svg.title: BioTSR 1.0.0: methods and capabilities
svg.desc: Table of the 20 BioTSR methods in four families, with their vertex type, scope and supported options: AA grouping and SSE annotation for the two protein Cα methods; mirror images for all Cα and atomic single-structure methods; size filtering for every method.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 20 methods in four families, read from the capability matrix released with BioTSR 1.0.0. Every method runs under one standard profile.
